AccessToken.description: Access token of the client application.

Client.description: Name and version of the client application.

Extent.title: Accounting item extent
Extent.description: Extent of data to be returned. E.g. it is possible to specify that together with the accounting items, credit card transactions should be also returned.

ItemIds.description: Unique identifiers of the Accounting items. Required if no other filter is provided.

RebatedItemIds.description: Unique identifiers of the Accounting items we are finding rebates for. Required if no other filter is provided.

ClosedUtc.title: Time interval
ClosedUtc.description: Interval in which the accounting item was closed. Required if no other filter is provided.

UpdatedUtc.title: Time interval
UpdatedUtc.description: Interval in which the accounting item was updated. Required if no other filter is provided.

ConsumedUtc.title: Time interval
ConsumedUtc.description: Interval in which the accounting item was consumed. Required if no other filter is provided.

Currency.description: ISO-4217 code of the `Currency` the item costs should be converted to.

States.description: States the accounting items should be in. If not specified, accounting items in `Open` or `Closed` states are returned.
